subject.title: fix(launcher): stop respawned children after parent death on Unix

question: Should maintainers refresh/adopt this conflicting contributor branch now, or wait for the contributor to rebase it before landing the launcher parent-death guard?
rationale: The implementation direction looks correct, but GitHub reports a dirty/conflicting head, so the safe landing path depends on who should resolve the current-base merge and rerun proof.

options.title: Refresh and land

options.title: Wait for contributor rebase
options.body: Leave the PR open and ask the contributor to resolve conflicts and repost focused validation before maintainer review continues.
